64	    def locate(self, node: str, rows: list[dict]) -> dict | None:
65	        path = self.directory / f"{node}.interactive.json"
66	        if not path.exists():
67	            return None
68	        receipt = read_json(path)
69	        if receipt["plan_digest"] != plan_digest(self.plan):
70	            raise RuntimeError("Plan changed; cannot reconcile session")
71	        background_id = receipt.get("background_id")
72	        if not background_id:
73	            log = self.directory / f"{node}.launch.log"
74	            if not log.exists():
75	                return None
76	            # --bg assigns its own UUID. Bind the ID printed by this launch;
77	            # never adopt a guessed UUID or a name-only match.
78	            ids = set(re.findall(r"claude attach ([a-f0-9-]{8,36})\s", log.read_text(errors="replace")))
79	            if len(ids) != 1:
80	                raise RuntimeError("Missing/ambiguous native launch ID; reconcile manually")
81	            background_id = ids.pop()
82	        matches = [row for row in rows if row.get("id") == background_id]
83	        if not matches:
84	            return None
85	        if len(matches) != 1:
86	            raise RuntimeError("Ambiguous Claude session identity")
87	        row = matches[0]
88	        if row.get("kind") != "background" or Path(row.get("cwd", "")).resolve() != self.node_worktree(node).resolve() or row.get("name") != self.launch_name(node):
89	            raise RuntimeError("Claude session identity/worktree mismatch")
90	        if receipt.get("background_id") and row.get("sessionId") != receipt.get("session_id"):
91	            raise RuntimeError("Native Claude UUID changed; refusing attachment")
92	        if not isinstance(row.get("sessionId"), str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[a-f0-9-]{36}", row["sessionId"]):
93	            raise RuntimeError("Missing native Claude UUID")
94	        # `done` is a finished TURN, not a terminated terminal. Require the
95	        # native live PID as well; stale registry rows must not imply restart.
96	        if row.get("state") not in {"idle", "working", "blocked", "done"}:
97	            raise RuntimeError(f"Session is not attachable: {row.get('state')!r}; reconcile manually")
98	        pid = row.get("pid")
99	        if not isinstance(pid, int) or pid <= 0:
100	            raise RuntimeError("No live native PID; reconcile session before attaching")
101	        try:
102	            os.kill(pid, 0)
103	        except OSError as error:
104	            raise RuntimeError("Native process is unavailable; refusing implicit restart") from error
105	        return row

107	    settle_seconds = 30.0
108	
109	    def settle(self, node: str) -> dict:
110	        """Bind the row created by the launch we just issued.
111	
112	        `claude --bg` exits before the native session has fully registered: the
113	        inventory row can appear without a PID for a moment. Poll for the exact
114	        row until it is attachable; identity mismatches still fail immediately
115	        and nothing is ever launched again from here.
116	        """
117	        deadline = time.monotonic() + self.settle_seconds
118	        while True:
119	            try:
120	                row = self.locate(node, self.inventory())
121	            except RuntimeError as error:
122	                if "No live native PID" not in str(error) or time.monotonic() >= deadline:
123	                    raise
124	                row = None
125	            if row is not None:
126	                return row
127	            if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
128	                raise RuntimeError("No exact matching background session after launch")
129	            time.sleep(1)

131	    def reconcile(self, node: str, path: Path, receipt: dict) -> dict:
132	        """An existing receipt binds the one session this intent produced; nothing is launched again."""
133	        if receipt["plan_digest"] != plan_digest(self.plan):
134	            raise RuntimeError("Plan changed; refusing session reuse")
135	        row = self.locate(node, self.inventory())
136	        if row is None:
137	            raise RuntimeError("Existing launch cannot be reconciled; no automatic relaunch")
138	        receipt.update(status="attached_session_available", background_id=row["id"], session_id=row["sessionId"], observed_state=row["state"], native_started_at=row.get("startedAt"))
139	        receipt.pop("error", None)
140	        save_json(path, receipt)
141	        return receipt

143	    def launch(self, node: str, path: Path, receipt: dict, command: list[str], cwd: Path) -> dict:
144	        """Run the short `claude --bg` helper once, then bind the exact row it created."""
145	        env = {key: value for key, value in os.environ.items() if not key.startswith("HERDR_")}
146	        try:
147	            # This command creates Claude's own persistent terminal, then exits.
148	            # Killing this short helper is NOT evidence that the session stopped.
149	            with (self.directory / f"{node}.launch.log").open("w") as log:
150	                try:
151	                    result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=cwd, env=env, stdout=log,
152	                                            stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True, timeout=self.timeout)
153	                finally:
154	                    log.flush()
155	                    os.fsync(log.fileno())
156	            if result.returncode != 0:
157	                raise RuntimeError(f"Claude background launch exited {result.returncode}; inspect launch log")
158	            row = self.settle(node)
159	            receipt.update(status="attached_session_available", background_id=row["id"], session_id=row["sessionId"], observed_state=row["state"], native_started_at=row.get("startedAt"))
160	        except BaseException as error:
161	            receipt.update(status="needs_reconciliation", error=str(error))
162	            raise
163	        finally:
164	            save_json(path, receipt)
165	        return receipt

167	    def run(self, node: str) -> dict:
168	        if node not in self.workers or self.plan.get("mode") != "interactive":
169	            raise ValueError("Expected an interactive worker plan")
170	        info = self.plan["nodes"][node]
171	        path = self.directory / f"{node}.interactive.json"
172	        if path.exists():
173	            return self.reconcile(node, path, read_json(path))
174	        cwd = Path(info["worktree"])
175	        if git(cwd, "rev-parse", "HEAD") != self.plan["base_commit"] or git(cwd, "status", "--porcelain"):
176	            raise RuntimeError("Worktree changed since preparation")
177	        # Native IDs do not exist until launch. Reject conflicting terminal names.
178	        if any(row.get("name") == self.launch_name(node) for row in self.inventory()):
179	            raise RuntimeError("Unowned session already exists with this launch name")
180	        receipt = {"node_id": node, "session_id": None, "launch_token": info["session_id"], "plan_digest": plan_digest(self.plan),
181	                   "worktree": str(cwd), "base_commit": self.plan["base_commit"],
182	                   "status": "launching", "attempt": 1, "launcher_invocations": 1,
183	                   "launch_requested_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}
184	        save_json(path, receipt)
185	        automatic = bool(self.plan.get("automatic"))
186	        if automatic:
187	            from .automatic import validate_automatic
188	            validate_automatic(self.plan)
189	        tools = "Read,Glob,Grep,Edit,Write" if self.plan["allow_edits"] else "Read,Glob,Grep"
190	        if automatic:
191	            tools += ",Bash"
192	        prompt = ("You are a workflow worker in your own worktree. A human can type directly into this terminal. "
193	                  "Do not launch agents, commit, merge, push or modify shared contracts. Stay within this worktree. "
194	                  "Report changed files, checks actually executed, and open assumptions. "
195	                  "Completion of a turn is not workflow approval.\n\n" + info["task"])
196	        if automatic:
197	            from .automatic import completion_prompt
198	            prompt += completion_prompt(self.directory, self.plan, node)
199	        # The exact prompt is run evidence (the viewer shows it); it is private like the receipts.
200	        write_private(self.directory / f"{node}.prompt.txt", prompt)
201	        command = [self.executable, "--bg", "--name", self.launch_name(node),
202	                   "--safe-mode", "--strict-mcp-config", "--mcp-config", '{"mcpServers":{}}',
203	                   "--tools", tools, "--permission-mode", "bypassPermissions" if automatic else "manual"]
204	        if automatic:
205	            command.append("--dangerously-skip-permissions")
206	        command.append(prompt)
207	        return self.launch(node, path, receipt, command, cwd)

209	    def run_reviewer(self, reviewer_id: str, prompt: str, launch_token: str, candidate_commit: str) -> dict:
210	        """Launch (or reconcile) one native reviewer session for this candidate.
211	
212	        Every reviewer reads the same candidate checkout and the run directory; its only
213	        permitted write is its own completion file, which the controller later validates.
214	        """
215	        if self.plan.get("mode") != "interactive":
216	            raise ValueError("Expected an interactive run plan")
217	        node = review_node(reviewer_id)
218	        path = self.directory / f"{node}.interactive.json"
219	        if path.exists():
220	            return self.reconcile(node, path, read_json(path))
221	        cwd = self.node_worktree(node)
222	        if not cwd.is_dir():
223	            raise RuntimeError("Review worktree is missing; the review node creates it before launching a reviewer")
224	        if git(cwd, "rev-parse", "HEAD") != candidate_commit or git(cwd, "status", "--porcelain"):
225	            raise RuntimeError("Review worktree is not at the clean candidate commit")
226	        if any(row.get("name") == self.launch_name(node) for row in self.inventory()):
227	            raise RuntimeError("Unowned session already exists with this launch name")
228	        receipt = {"node_id": node, "session_id": None, "launch_token": launch_token, "plan_digest": plan_digest(self.plan),
229	                   "worktree": str(cwd), "base_commit": self.plan["base_commit"], "candidate_commit": candidate_commit,
230	                   "status": "launching", "attempt": 1, "launcher_invocations": 1,
231	                   "launch_requested_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}
232	        save_json(path, receipt)
233	        write_private(self.directory / f"{node}.prompt.txt", prompt)
234	        # Claude permission rules spell absolute paths as //absolute/path, and file writes are
235	        # governed by the Edit rule family (Write, Edit, NotebookEdit): under dontAsk a rule
236	        # spelled Write(...) never matches and every write is denied (seen live), while
237	        # Edit(//<path>) allows exactly that file and keeps every other write denied.
238	        completion = str(self.directory / f"{node}.completion.json").lstrip("/")
239	        # --tools, --allowedTools and --add-dir are variadic: any of them directly before the
240	        # positional prompt would swallow it (the session would start idle, without a task).
241	        # The prompt therefore follows --permission-mode, which takes exactly one value.
242	        command = [self.executable, "--bg", "--name", self.launch_name(node),
243	                   "--safe-mode", "--strict-mcp-config", "--mcp-config", '{"mcpServers":{}}',
244	                   "--tools", "Read,Glob,Grep,Write", "--allowedTools", f"Edit(//{completion})",
245	                   "--add-dir", str(self.directory), "--permission-mode", "dontAsk", prompt]
246	        return self.launch(node, path, receipt, command, cwd)
247	
248	    def status(self) -> dict:
249	        rows = self.inventory()
250	        result = {}
251	        nodes = [*self.workers] + [node for node in review_nodes(self.plan) if (self.directory / f"{node}.interactive.json").exists()]
252	        for node in nodes:
253	            path = self.directory / f"{node}.interactive.json"
254	            row = self.locate(node, rows)
255	            result[node] = {"receipt": read_json(path) if path.exists() else None,
256	                            "current_session": row, "verified": False}
257	        return result

269	def build_interactive_graph(checkpointer, sessions: InteractiveSessions):
270	    """Launch-only graph: one `launch_<lane>` node per lane of the plan, then a human handoff interrupt."""
271	    def launcher(node):
272	        return lambda _state: {"lanes": {node: sessions.run(node)}}
273	
274	    def handoff(state: SessionState):
275	        interrupt({"kind": "interactive_workers_active", "run_id": state["run_id"],
276	                   "message": "Type directly in the Claude panels. Idle is not completion. Explicit evidence/review handoff is still required."})
277	        raise RuntimeError("Verification/integration handoff is not implemented yet")
278	
279	    class LaunchState(TypedDict, total=False):
280	        run_id: str
281	        lanes: Annotated[dict, merge_lanes]
282	
283	    graph = StateGraph(LaunchState)
284	    launches = [f"launch_{node}" for node in sessions.workers]
285	    for node, name in zip(sessions.workers, launches):
286	        graph.add_node(name, launcher(node))
287	    graph.add_node("human_handoff", handoff)
288	    for name in launches:
289	        graph.add_edge(START, name)
290	    graph.add_edge(launches, "human_handoff")
291	    graph.add_edge("human_handoff", END)
292	    return graph.compile(checkpointer=checkpointer)

295	def require_shell(pane_id: str, settle_seconds: float = 10.0) -> None:
296	    """Only type into a pane whose sole foreground process is its own idle shell.
297	
298	    A pane Herdr just created reports no shell, or a shell still running its
299	    startup files, for a moment. Poll briefly for the idle-shell state; a pane
300	    that is still occupied at the deadline is refused, never typed into.
301	    """
302	    deadline = time.monotonic() + settle_seconds
303	    while True:
304	        process = herdr("pane", "process-info", "--pane", pane_id)["result"]["process_info"]
305	        foreground = process.get("foreground_processes", [])
306	        shell_pid = process.get("shell_pid")
307	        if shell_pid and len(foreground) == 1 and foreground[0].get("pid") == shell_pid:
308	            return
309	        if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
310	            raise RuntimeError(f"Pane {pane_id} is occupied; refusing to type an attach command into it")
311	        time.sleep(0.5)

314	def attach_panels(sessions: InteractiveSessions, reuse_observers: Path | None = None) -> dict:
315	    directory = sessions.directory
316	    mapping_path = directory / "terminals.json"
317	    workers = list(sessions.workers)
318	    reviewers = review_nodes(sessions.plan)
319	    if mapping_path.exists():
320	        mapping = read_json(mapping_path)
321	        if set(workers) <= set(mapping) and any(node not in mapping and (directory / f"{node}.interactive.json").exists() for node in reviewers):
322	            # The workers' tab exists and a reviewer appeared after it: add only the missing reviewer panes.
323	            return attach_reviewer_panel(sessions)
324	        raise RuntimeError("Terminal mappings already exist; use attach-one inside an available terminal to reconnect")
325	    rows = sessions.inventory()
326	    for node in workers:
327	        receipt = read_json(directory / f"{node}.interactive.json")
328	        if receipt["plan_digest"] != plan_digest(sessions.plan) or sessions.locate(node, rows) is None:
329	            raise RuntimeError("Cannot attach an unverified/missing session")
330	    caller = herdr("pane", "current", "--current")["result"]["pane"]
331	    source = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
332	    if reuse_observers:
333	        mapping = read_json(reuse_observers)
334	        if set(mapping) != set(workers) or any(value.get("mode") != "read-only-observer" for value in mapping.values()):
335	            raise RuntimeError("Can only replace explicitly identified read-only observer panels")
336	        if len({value["pane_id"] for value in mapping.values()}) != len(workers):
337	            raise RuntimeError("Observer pane identities must be distinct")
338	        tabs = set()
339	        for entry in mapping.values():
340	            pane = herdr("pane", "get", entry["pane_id"])["result"]["pane"]
341	            if pane["workspace_id"] != caller["workspace_id"] or pane["tab_id"] != entry["tab_id"] or pane["tab_id"] == caller["tab_id"]:
342	                raise RuntimeError("Observer pane moved or is not in a dedicated tab in this workspace")
343	            require_shell(entry["pane_id"])
344	            tabs.add(pane["tab_id"])
345	        if len(tabs) != 1:
346	            raise RuntimeError("Workers must share a dedicated workflow tab")
347	        # Consume the old observer mapping before any attach command is sent.
348	        for entry in mapping.values():
349	            entry.update(mode="transferred-to-interactive", transferred_to=str(directory))
350	        save_json(reuse_observers, mapping)
351	        save_json(mapping_path, mapping)
352	        herdr("tab", "rename", next(iter(tabs)), f"Workflow: {directory.name}")
353	    else:
354	        # The first lane takes the tab's root pane; each following lane splits right of the previous one.
355	        created = herdr("tab", "create", "--workspace", caller["workspace_id"], "--cwd", str(source),
356	                        "--label", f"Workflow: {directory.name}", "--no-focus")["result"]
357	        tab_id = created["tab"]["tab_id"]
358	        mapping = {workers[0]: {"pane_id": created["root_pane"]["pane_id"], "tab_id": tab_id, "mode": "allocated"}}
359	        save_json(mapping_path, mapping)
360	        for previous, node in zip(workers, workers[1:]):
361	            split = herdr("pane", "split", "--pane", mapping[previous]["pane_id"], "--direction", "right", "--cwd", str(source), "--no-focus")["result"]
362	            mapping[node] = {"pane_id": split["pane"]["pane_id"], "tab_id": tab_id, "mode": "allocated"}
363	            save_json(mapping_path, mapping)
364	    # Reviewers that already exist (attach after the review node started) get their panes now, in declared
365	    # order; otherwise the review node adds them through attach_reviewer_panel as it launches them.
366	    for node in reviewers:
367	        if (directory / f"{node}.interactive.json").exists() and sessions.locate(node, rows) is not None:
368	            allocate_reviewer_pane(sessions, mapping, mapping_path, node)
369	    for node, entry in mapping.items():
370	        attach_pane(sessions, mapping, mapping_path, node, sessions.locate(node, rows)["sessionId"])
371	    return mapping

374	def allocate_reviewer_pane(sessions: InteractiveSessions, mapping: dict, mapping_path: Path, node: str = REVIEW) -> None:
375	    """A reviewer pane splits right of the previous pane: the last lane's for the first reviewer, then each reviewer's predecessor."""
376	    source = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
377	    reviewers = review_nodes(sessions.plan)
378	    earlier = [item for item in reviewers[:reviewers.index(node)] if item in mapping] if node in reviewers else []
379	    last = mapping[earlier[-1] if earlier else sessions.workers[-1]]
380	    split = herdr("pane", "split", "--pane", last["pane_id"], "--direction", "right", "--cwd", str(source), "--no-focus")["result"]
381	    mapping[node] = {"pane_id": split["pane"]["pane_id"], "tab_id": last["tab_id"], "mode": "allocated"}
382	    save_json(mapping_path, mapping)

385	def attach_pane(sessions: InteractiveSessions, mapping: dict, mapping_path: Path, node: str, session_id: str) -> None:
386	    source = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
387	    entry = mapping[node]
388	    require_shell(entry["pane_id"])
389	    herdr("pane", "rename", entry["pane_id"], pane_label(node))
390	    # Re-check identity in the actual attachment process immediately before exec.
391	    command = shlex.join([sys.executable, "-m", "workflow.interactive", "attach-one", str(sessions.directory), "--node", node])
392	    command = f"cd {shlex.quote(str(source))} && {command}"
393	    entry.update(mode="attach_requested", session_id=session_id)
394	    save_json(mapping_path, mapping)
395	    herdr("pane", "run", entry["pane_id"], command)

398	def attach_reviewer_panel(sessions: InteractiveSessions) -> dict:
399	    """Add a `Claude: reviewer <id>` pane beside the workers' panes for every launched reviewer that has none yet, in declared order."""
400	    directory = sessions.directory
401	    mapping_path = directory / "terminals.json"
402	    if not mapping_path.exists():
403	        raise RuntimeError("No terminal mappings; attach the worker panes before the reviewer pane")
404	    mapping = read_json(mapping_path)
405	    if not set(sessions.workers) <= set(mapping):
406	        raise RuntimeError("Terminal mappings lack the worker panes; refusing to add a reviewer pane")
407	    reviewers = review_nodes(sessions.plan)
408	    launched = [node for node in reviewers if (directory / f"{node}.interactive.json").exists()]
409	    if not launched:
410	        raise RuntimeError("No reviewer session receipt; nothing to attach")
411	    missing = [node for node in launched if node not in mapping]
412	    if not missing:
413	        raise RuntimeError(f"Reviewer pane already allocated; use attach-one --node {launched[-1]} inside an available terminal to reconnect")
414	    rows = sessions.inventory()
415	    for node in missing:
416	        if read_json(directory / f"{node}.interactive.json")["plan_digest"] != plan_digest(sessions.plan):
417	            raise RuntimeError("Plan changed; cannot attach the reviewer")
418	        row = sessions.locate(node, rows)
419	        if row is None:
420	            raise RuntimeError(f"Cannot attach an unverified/missing reviewer session ({node})")
421	        allocate_reviewer_pane(sessions, mapping, mapping_path, node)
422	        attach_pane(sessions, mapping, mapping_path, node, row["sessionId"])
423	    return mapping

426	def main():
427	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
428	    parser.add_argument("action", choices=["prepare", "run", "status", "attach", "attach-one"])
429	    parser.add_argument("directory", type=Path)
430	    parser.add_argument("--repo", type=Path, default=Path.cwd())
431	    parser.add_argument("--base", default="HEAD")
432	    parser.add_argument("--task", action="append", metavar="LANE=PATH", help="prepare: task file for one lane; repeat once per lane")
433	    parser.add_argument("--allow-edits", action="store_true")
434	    parser.add_argument("--live", action="store_true")
435	    parser.add_argument("--herdr", action="store_true")
436	    parser.add_argument("--reuse-observers", type=Path)
437	    parser.add_argument("--node", help="attach-one: a worker lane of the run, or a reviewer node (review, or review-<id>)")
438	    args = parser.parse_args()
439	    directory = args.directory.resolve()
440	    try:
441	        if args.action == "prepare":
442	            from .pipeline import parse_lane_files
443	            task_files = parse_lane_files(args.task, "--task")
444	            if not task_files:
445	                parser.error("prepare requires --task <lane>=<path> for every lane")
446	            plan = prepare(directory, args.repo, args.base, {node: path.read_text() for node, path in task_files.items()}, args.allow_edits)
447	            plan["mode"] = "interactive"
448	            save_json(directory / "plan.json", plan)
449	            print(json.dumps(plan, indent=2))
450	            return
451	        sessions = InteractiveSessions(directory, timeout=45)
452	        if sessions.plan.get("mode") != "interactive":
453	            parser.error("Not an interactive run; prepare a new run instead of converting print-mode sessions")
454	        if args.action == "status":
455	            print(json.dumps(sessions.status(), indent=2))
456	            return
457	        if args.action == "attach-one":
458	            if not args.node or not sys.stdin.isatty():
459	                parser.error("attach-one requires --node and an interactive terminal")
460	            if args.node not in sessions.workers and args.node not in review_nodes(sessions.plan):
461	                parser.error(f"--node must be a lane of this run ({', '.join(sessions.workers)}) or {', '.join(review_nodes(sessions.plan))}")
462	            receipt = read_json(directory / f"{args.node}.interactive.json")
463	            if receipt["plan_digest"] != plan_digest(sessions.plan):
464	                raise RuntimeError("Plan changed; cannot attach")
465	            row = sessions.locate(args.node, sessions.inventory())
466	            if row is None:
467	                raise RuntimeError("Session unavailable; refusing implicit restart")
468	            os.chdir(sessions.node_worktree(args.node))
469	            os.execvp(sessions.executable, [sessions.executable, "attach", row["id"]])
470	        with run_lock(directory):

473	                return

476	            with SqliteSaver.from_conn_string(str(directory / "interactive-checkpoints.sqlite")) as saver:

1	"""Reusable policy/evidence gates. No agents, browsers, shells or graph launches.
2	
3	Inputs must come from a trusted verifier plus backend-owned artifact registry, not
4	unchecked agent prose. Passing this evidence gate never authorizes integration.
5	"""
6	from __future__ import annotations
7	
8	import hashlib
9	import json
10	import shlex
11	from datetime import datetime
12	from pathlib import Path
13	
14	from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator, FormatChecker
15	from jsonschema.exceptions import ValidationError
16	
17	CONTRACTS = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "contracts" / "workflow"
18	
19	
20	# Check kinds that only mean something on the whole application: a lane's build and browser
21	# suite compile against contracts and a server that another lane of the same run may be
22	# changing. The worker phase still runs and records them on the lane's isolated snapshot,
23	# but only the candidate phase, where every lane's work is combined, gates on them.
24	# Lane-local kinds (unit, contract, integration) gate in both phases.
25	DEFERRED_WORKER_KINDS = frozenset({"build", "browser"})
26	
27	
28	def validate_schema(name: str, value: dict) -> None:
29	    schema = json.loads((CONTRACTS / f"{name}.schema.json").read_text())
30	    Draft202012Validator(schema, format_checker=FormatChecker()).validate(value)

33	def policy_digest(policy: dict) -> str:
34	    """Canonical UTF-8 JSON: sorted keys, no whitespace, literal Unicode."""
35	    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(policy, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest()
36	
37	
38	def safe_path(value: str) -> str:
39	    normalized = value.rstrip("/")
40	    if not normalized or normalized.startswith("/") or any(char in normalized for char in "\\:*?[]") or any(part in {"", ".", ".."} for part in normalized.split("/")):
41	        raise ValueError(f"Not an exact repository-relative path/prefix: {value}")
42	    return normalized
43	
44	
45	def owns(path: str, prefix: str) -> bool:
46	    return path == prefix or path.startswith(prefix + "/")
47	
48	
49	def unique(items: list[dict], key: str) -> dict:
50	    result = {item[key]: item for item in items}
51	    if len(result) != len(items):
52	        raise ValueError(f"Duplicate {key}")
53	    return result
54	
55	
56	# Policies before 1.2.0 derived the required check kinds from the role; the export of an old run keeps them.
57	ROLE_REQUIRED_KINDS = {"frontend": ("build", "browser"), "backend": ("unit",)}
58	
59	
60	def required_kinds(policy: dict, worker: dict) -> list[str]:
61	    """The check kinds a lane must pass: declared from policy 1.2.0, derived from the role before."""
62	    if "required_check_kinds" in worker:
63	        return list(worker["required_check_kinds"])
64	    if policy.get("version") in {"1.0.0", "1.1.0"} and worker.get("role") in ROLE_REQUIRED_KINDS:
65	        return list(ROLE_REQUIRED_KINDS[worker["role"]])
66	    raise ValueError(f"{worker.get('node_id')} declares no required_check_kinds")
67	
68	
69	def validate_policy(policy: dict) -> dict:
70	    validate_schema("verification", policy)
71	    workers = unique(policy["workers"], "node_id")
72	    claimed = []
73	    for worker in workers.values():
74	        paths = [safe_path(path) for path in worker["owned_paths"]]
75	        for other_node, other_path in claimed:
76	            if any(owns(path, other_path) or owns(other_path, path) for path in paths):
77	                raise ValueError(f"Overlapping ownership: {worker['node_id']} and {other_node}")
78	        claimed.extend((worker["node_id"], path) for path in paths)
79	        checks = unique(worker["checks"], "id")
80	        if len({tuple(check["argv"]) for check in checks.values()}) != len(checks):
81	            raise ValueError("Each check needs a distinct command")
82	        kinds = {check["kind"] for check in checks.values()}
83	        required = set(required_kinds(policy, worker))
84	        if not required <= kinds:
85	            raise ValueError(f"{worker['node_id']} requires {sorted(required)} checks; missing {sorted(required - kinds)}")
86	        for check in checks.values():
87	            unique(check["scenarios"], "id")
88	            if (check["kind"] == "browser") != bool(check["scenarios"]):
89	                raise ValueError("Browser checks require named scenarios; other checks must not have scenarios")
90	    drill = policy.get("failure_drill")
91	    if drill and (drill["node_id"] not in workers or policy.get("max_verification_attempts", 3) < 2):
92	        raise ValueError("Failure drill requires a configured worker and at least two allowed verification attempts")
93	    return policy
94	
95	
96	def evaluate_worker(policy: dict, result: dict, evidence: dict, *, expected: dict,
97	                    artifact_root: Path, artifact_paths: dict[str, Path], enforce_ownership: bool = True,
98	                    phase: str = "candidate") -> dict:
99	    """Fail closed on absent, stale or inconsistent evidence.
100	
101	    `expected` is backend-owned: run_id, node_id, attempt, base_commit,
102	    output_commit and verification_cwd. Caller must freeze edits and independently
103	    derive the full Git diff/commit before invoking; this function cannot prove
104	    that an agent has reported all changed files.
105	
106	    In the `worker` phase, checks of a DEFERRED_WORKER_KINDS kind are verified for
107	    integrity (approved argv, worktree, timeout) and recorded, but their outcome does
108	    not gate; the returned `deferred_checks` names them. Every other phase gates on all.
109	    """
110	    reasons = []
111	    deferred = []
112	    try:
113	        validate_policy(policy)
114	        validate_schema("workerResult", result)
115	        validate_schema("verificationEvidence", evidence)
116	        workers = {worker["node_id"]: worker for worker in policy["workers"]}
117	        worker = workers[expected["node_id"]]
118	        for field in ("run_id", "node_id", "attempt", "base_commit", "output_commit"):
119	            if result[field] != expected[field]:
120	                raise ValueError(f"Worker result has stale/mismatched {field}")
121	        for field in ("run_id", "node_id", "attempt", "output_commit"):
122	            if evidence[field] != expected[field]:
123	                raise ValueError(f"Verification evidence has stale/mismatched {field}")
124	        if evidence["policy_sha256"] != policy_digest(policy):
125	            raise ValueError("Verification policy changed after evidence capture")
126	        if result["status"] != "succeeded" or result["output_commit"] is None or result["error"] is not None:
127	            raise ValueError("Worker did not produce a successful durable result")
128	        prefixes = [safe_path(path) for path in worker["owned_paths"]]
129	        for changed in result["changed_files"]:
130	            if enforce_ownership and not any(owns(safe_path(changed), prefix) for prefix in prefixes):
131	                reasons.append(f"Changed file outside ownership: {changed}")
132	        artifacts = unique(result["artifacts"], "artifact_id")
133	        root = artifact_root.resolve(strict=True)
134	        resolved = {}
135	        for artifact_id, artifact in artifacts.items():
136	            path = artifact_paths[artifact_id].resolve(strict=True)
137	            if not path.is_relative_to(root) or not path.is_file():
138	                raise ValueError(f"Artifact escapes registry root: {artifact_id}")
139	            with path.open("rb") as handle:
140	                digest = hashlib.file_digest(handle, "sha256").hexdigest()
141	            if digest != artifact["sha256"]:
142	                raise ValueError(f"Artifact hash mismatch: {artifact_id}")
143	            resolved[artifact_id] = path
144	        supplied = unique(evidence["checks"], "id")
145	        required = {check["id"]: check for check in worker["checks"]}
146	        if set(supplied) != set(required):
147	            raise ValueError("Required check evidence missing or contains unknown check IDs")
148	        indexes = [check["worker_check_index"] for check in supplied.values()]
149	        if len(set(indexes)) != len(indexes):
150	            raise ValueError("A command execution cannot satisfy multiple check IDs")
151	        if phase == "worker":
152	            deferred = sorted(check_id for check_id, check in required.items() if check["kind"] in DEFERRED_WORKER_KINDS)
153	        deferred_indexes = {supplied[check_id]["worker_check_index"] for check_id in deferred}
154	        for index, check in enumerate(result["checks"]):
155	            if artifacts.get(check["log_artifact_id"], {}).get("kind") != "log":
156	                reasons.append("Executed check is missing a log artifact")
157	            if datetime.fromisoformat(check["finished_at"]) < datetime.fromisoformat(check["started_at"]):
158	                reasons.append("Check finish precedes start")
159	            if check["exit_code"] != 0 and index not in deferred_indexes:
160	                reasons.append(f"Executed check failed: {check['command']}")
161	        for check_id, requirement in required.items():
162	            receipt = supplied[check_id]
163	            execution = result["checks"][receipt["worker_check_index"]]
164	            if execution["command"] != shlex.join(requirement["argv"]):
165	                reasons.append(f"{check_id}: executed command differs from approved argv")
166	            if Path(execution["cwd"]).resolve() != Path(expected["verification_cwd"]).resolve():
167	                reasons.append(f"{check_id}: wrong verification worktree")
168	            duration = (datetime.fromisoformat(execution["finished_at"]) - datetime.fromisoformat(execution["started_at"])).total_seconds()
169	            if duration > requirement["timeout_seconds"]:
170	                reasons.append(f"{check_id}: execution exceeded approved timeout")
171	            if check_id in deferred:
172	                continue  # Executed and recorded; the candidate phase gates on the outcome.
173	            if requirement["kind"] in {"unit", "browser", "integration", "contract"}:
174	                tests = receipt["tests"]
175	                if tests is None or tests["passed"] < 1 or tests["failed"] > 0:
176	                    reasons.append(f"{check_id}: no passing test evidence or failed tests")
177	            scenarios = unique(receipt["scenarios"], "id")
178	            if requirement["kind"] == "browser" and receipt["tests"] is not None and receipt["tests"]["passed"] < len(requirement["scenarios"]):
179	                reasons.append(f"{check_id}: fewer passing tests than required browser scenarios")
180	            if set(scenarios) != {scenario["id"] for scenario in requirement["scenarios"]}:
181	                reasons.append(f"{check_id}: missing/unknown browser scenarios")
182	            screenshot_ids = []
183	            for scenario in scenarios.values():
184	                artifact_id = scenario["screenshot_artifact_id"]
185	                if scenario["status"] != "passed":
186	                    reasons.append(f"{check_id}/{scenario['id']}: browser scenario did not pass")
187	                if artifact_id is None or artifacts.get(artifact_id, {}).get("kind") != "screenshot":
188	                    reasons.append(f"{check_id}/{scenario['id']}: screenshot required")
189	                    continue
190	                screenshot_ids.append(artifact_id)
191	                # Format sanity only, not proof of visual correctness/authenticity.
192	                with resolved[artifact_id].open("rb") as image:
193	                    header = image.read(24)
194	                if len(header) < 24 or header[:8] != b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n" or header[12:16] != b"IHDR" or int.from_bytes(header[16:20], "big") == 0 or int.from_bytes(header[20:24], "big") == 0:
195	                    reasons.append(f"{check_id}/{scenario['id']}: expected a PNG screenshot")
196	            if len(set(screenshot_ids)) != len(screenshot_ids):
197	                reasons.append(f"{check_id}: each scenario needs a distinct screenshot artifact")
198	    except (ValueError, KeyError, IndexError, TypeError, OSError) as error:
199	        reasons.append(str(error))
200	    except ValidationError as error:
201	        reasons.append(error.message)
202	    return {"status": "blocked" if reasons else "passed", "reasons": reasons, "deferred_checks": deferred,
203	            "pending_gates": ["independent_review", "integration_approval"],
204	            "integration_allowed": False}

1	"""Local, isolated check execution and artifact capture. Never launches agents."""
2	from __future__ import annotations
3	
4	import hashlib
5	import json
6	import os
7	import re
8	import shlex
9	import shutil
10	import signal
11	import subprocess
12	import sys
13	import tempfile

21	def now() -> str:
22	    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
23	
24	
25	def execute(argv: list[str], cwd: Path, log: Path, timeout: int, env: dict) -> tuple[int, str, str]:
26	    started = now()
27	    with log.open("wb") as output:
28	        process = subprocess.Popen(argv, cwd=cwd, env=env, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
29	                                   stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True)
30	        try:
31	            code = process.wait(timeout=timeout)
32	        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
33	            terminate(process)
34	            output.write(b"\nWORKFLOW: timeout; process group terminated\n")
35	            code = 124
36	        except BaseException:
37	            terminate(process)
38	            raise
39	        finally:
40	            # Test runners must not leave servers or descendant writers alive.
41	            # terminate also signals the group after the group leader has exited.
42	            terminate(process)
43	            try:
44	                os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
45	            except ProcessLookupError:
46	                pass
47	            output.flush()
48	            os.fsync(output.fileno())
49	    return code, started, now()

52	def text_test_counts(log: str) -> dict | None:
53	    text = re.sub(r"\x1b\[[0-?]*[ -/]*[@-~]", "", log)
54	    unit = re.search(r"^Ran (\d+) tests? in .+$", text, re.MULTILINE)
55	    if unit:
56	        total = int(unit[1])
57	        skipped = re.search(r"\bskipped=(\d+)", text)
58	        skipped = int(skipped[1]) if skipped else 0
59	        failures = sum(int(value) for value in re.findall(r"\b(?:failures|errors|unexpected successes)=(\d+)", text))
60	        if not re.search(r"^(?:OK(?:\s|$)|FAILED\s*\()", text, re.MULTILINE):
61	            return None
62	        return {"passed": max(0, total - skipped - failures), "failed": failures, "skipped": skipped}
63	    # Node's TAP and spec reporters. Require a complete self-consistent summary.
64	    counts = {}
65	    for key in ("tests", "pass", "fail", "skipped", "cancelled", "todo"):
66	        found = re.findall(rf"^[#ℹ]\s+{key}\s+(\d+)\s*$", text, re.MULTILINE)
67	        if found:
68	            counts[key] = int(found[-1])
69	    if {"tests", "pass", "fail", "skipped"} <= counts.keys():
70	        if sum(counts.get(key, 0) for key in ("pass", "fail", "skipped", "cancelled", "todo")) == counts["tests"]:
71	            return {"passed": counts["pass"], "failed": counts["fail"] + counts.get("cancelled", 0),
72	                    "skipped": counts["skipped"] + counts.get("todo", 0)}
73	    return None
74	
75	
76	class Capture:
77	    def __init__(self, directory: Path):
78	        self.directory = directory
79	        self.artifacts = []
80	        self.paths = {}
81	
82	    def add(self, source: Path, kind: str) -> str:
83	        if not source.is_file() or source.is_symlink():
84	            raise ValueError("Evidence must be a regular file")
85	        content = source.read_bytes()
86	        digest = hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()
87	        artifact_id = f"{kind}-{len(self.artifacts)}-{digest[:12]}"
88	        destination = self.directory / artifact_id
89	        with destination.open("xb") as handle:
90	            handle.write(content)
91	            handle.flush()
92	            os.fsync(handle.fileno())
93	        destination.chmod(0o400)
94	        self.artifacts.append({"artifact_id": artifact_id, "kind": kind,
95	                               "uri": destination.name, "sha256": digest})
96	        self.paths[artifact_id] = destination
97	        return artifact_id

100	def browser_evidence(report_path: Path, output_root: Path, requirement: dict, capture: Capture) -> tuple[dict, list]:
101	    report = json.loads(report_path.read_text())
102	    if report.get("errors"):
103	        raise ValueError("Playwright reported global errors")
104	    specs = []
105	    def walk(suite):
106	        specs.extend(suite.get("specs", []))
107	        for child in suite.get("suites", []):
108	            walk(child)
109	    walk(report)
110	    required = {case["id"] for case in requirement["scenarios"]}
111	    found = {}
112	    counts = {"passed": 0, "failed": 0, "skipped": 0}
113	    for spec in specs:
114	        for test in spec.get("tests", []):
115	            results = test.get("results", [])
116	            # No flaky retries or expected failures counted as passing verification.
117	            passed = test.get("status") == "expected" and test.get("expectedStatus") == "passed" and len(results) == 1 and results[0].get("status") == "passed"
118	            skipped = test.get("status") == "skipped"
119	            counts["passed" if passed else "skipped" if skipped else "failed"] += 1
120	            matches = set(re.findall(r"\[scenario:([^\]]+)\]", spec.get("title", ""))) & required
121	            for scenario_id in matches:
122	                if scenario_id in found:
123	                    raise ValueError(f"Duplicate browser scenario/project result: {scenario_id}")
124	                screenshot = None
125	                if passed:
126	                    attachments = [item for item in results[0].get("attachments", [])
127	                                   if item.get("name") == f"screenshot:{scenario_id}" and item.get("contentType") == "image/png"]
128	                    if len(attachments) != 1:
129	                        raise ValueError(f"Expected one screenshot attachment for {scenario_id}")
130	                    path = Path(attachments[0].get("path", "")).resolve(strict=True)
131	                    if not path.is_relative_to(output_root.resolve()):
132	                        raise ValueError("Screenshot attachment outside isolated browser output directory")
133	                    screenshot = capture.add(path, "screenshot")
134	                found[scenario_id] = {"id": scenario_id, "status": "passed" if passed else "skipped" if skipped else "failed",
135	                                      "screenshot_artifact_id": screenshot}
136	    if set(found) != required:
137	        raise ValueError("Playwright report does not cover every required scenario")
138	    return counts, list(found.values())

141	def verify_revision(run: Path, plan: dict, policy: dict, node: str, commit: str, changed: list[str],
142	                    session_id: str, phase: str = "worker", attempt: int = 1) -> dict:
143	    """One fresh verification worktree per node/phase/attempt, artifacts retained."""
144	    worker = next(worker for worker in policy["workers"] if worker["node_id"] == node)
145	    directory = run / "verification" / phase / node / str(attempt)
146	    packet_path = directory / "packet.json"
147	    if packet_path.exists():
148	        packet = json.loads(packet_path.read_text())
149	        if packet["expected"]["output_commit"] != commit or packet["evidence"]["policy_sha256"] != policy_digest(policy):
150	            raise ValueError("Existing verification belongs to a different revision/policy")
151	        return recheck_packet(packet, policy, run)
152	    if directory.exists():
153	        raise RuntimeError("Interrupted check attempt exists; use an explicitly incremented attempt")
154	    directory.mkdir(parents=True, mode=0o700)
155	    worktree = directory / "worktree"
156	    subprocess.run(["git", "-C", plan["repository"], "worktree", "add", "--detach", str(worktree), commit], check=True, capture_output=True)
157	    if git(worktree, "rev-parse", "HEAD") != commit or git(worktree, "status", "--porcelain"):
158	        raise RuntimeError("Verification worktree did not start clean at expected revision")
159	    artifacts_dir = directory / "artifacts"
160	    artifacts_dir.mkdir()
161	    capture = Capture(artifacts_dir)
162	    env = {key: value for key, value in os.environ.items() if not key.startswith("HERDR_")}
163	    for key in list(env):
164	        if key.startswith("PLAYWRIGHT_JSON_OUTPUT"):
165	            del env[key]  # The runner owns JSON capture, not inherited reporter paths.
166	    # Share installed browser executables read-only, not profiles or test caches.
167	    if sys.platform == "linux":
168	        env.setdefault("PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH", str(Path(env.get("XDG_CACHE_HOME", str(Path.home() / ".cache"))) / "ms-playwright"))
169	    env.update(PATH=str(Path(sys.executable).parent) + os.pathsep + env.get("PATH", ""),
170	               PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1", NO_COLOR="1", FORCE_COLOR="0", CI="1",
171	               WORKFLOW_VERIFICATION_PHASE=phase)
172	    for name in ("XDG_CACHE_HOME", "npm_config_cache"):
173	        path = directory / name.lower()
174	        path.mkdir()
175	        env[name] = str(path)
176	    # Unix domain sockets (tsx IPC, Chromium) are limited to ~107 bytes of path, so the
177	    # lane's TMPDIR cannot live under the run directory. It is private to this lane,
178	    # holds no evidence, and is removed once the checks finish.
179	    tmpdir = lane_tmpdir()
180	    env["TMPDIR"] = str(tmpdir)
181	    executions, receipts, errors, effective_commands = [], [], [], []
182	    try:
183	        run_lane_commands(policy, worker, worktree, directory, env, capture, executions, receipts, errors, effective_commands)
184	    finally:
185	        shutil.rmtree(tmpdir, ignore_errors=True)
186	    # Source edits by checks invalidate the evidence. Ignored caches are allowed.
187	    if git(worktree, "rev-parse", "HEAD") != commit or git(worktree, "status", "--porcelain"):
188	        errors.append("Verification modified the tested source revision")
189	    expected = {"run_id": plan["run_id"], "node_id": node, "attempt": attempt, "base_commit": plan["base_commit"],
190	                "output_commit": commit, "verification_cwd": str(worktree)}
191	    result = {"contract_version": "1.0.0", **{key: value for key, value in expected.items() if key != "verification_cwd"},
192	              "session_id": session_id, "status": "succeeded", "changed_files": changed,
193	              "checks": executions, "open_assumptions": [], "artifacts": capture.artifacts,
194	              "summary": f"Trusted {phase} check capture; not integration approval", "error": None}
195	    evidence = {"version": "1.0.0", "policy_sha256": policy_digest(policy),
196	                **{key: expected[key] for key in ("run_id", "node_id", "attempt", "output_commit")}, "checks": receipts}
197	    packet = {"phase": phase, "expected": expected, "result": result, "evidence": evidence,
198	              "artifact_root": str(artifacts_dir), "artifact_paths": {key: str(path) for key, path in capture.paths.items()},
199	              "capture_errors": errors, "effective_commands": effective_commands, "tmpdir": str(tmpdir)}
200	    packet = recheck_packet(packet, policy, run)
201	    save_json(packet_path, packet)
202	    return packet

205	SOCKET_PATH_LIMIT = 107  # sun_path on Linux, excluding the terminating NUL.
206	SOCKET_NAME_ALLOWANCE = len("/tsx-4294967295/4294967295.pipe")
207	
208	
209	def lane_tmpdir() -> Path:
210	    """A short private temp directory whose sockets fit within sun_path."""

570	    """Read-only view of a run directory for re-exporting run-state.json.
571	
572	    It constructs no sessions and touches no worktree, so a copied or finished
573	    run whose worktrees are gone still exports. Contradictory files are refused.
574	    """

576	    def __init__(self, directory: Path):
577	        self.directory = directory.resolve()
578	        self.plan = read_json(self.directory / "plan.json")
579	        if "automatic" in self.plan:
580	            from .automatic import validate_automatic
581	            validate_automatic(self.plan)
582	        self.policy = None
583	        policy_path = self.directory / "policy.json"
584	        if policy_path.exists():
585	            self.policy = validate_pipeline_policy(read_json(policy_path))
586	            if self.plan.get("policy_sha256") != policy_digest(self.policy):
587	                raise ValueError("Pinned policy changed")
588	        self.workers, self.excluded = lanes_of(self.plan, self.policy)
589	        review_path = self.directory / "review.json"
590	        if review_path.exists():

593	                raise ValueError("review.json exists without review-bundle.json; contradictory run directory")
594	            # Packet hashes are not rechecked here; the adapter re-verifies packets itself. Reviews recorded
595	            # before configured lanes may attribute a finding to `both`; the viewer renders it as several lanes.
596	            check_review(read_json(review_path), read_json(bundle_path), digest_file(bundle_path), require_approved=False,

600	def lanes_of(plan: dict, policy: dict | None) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
601	    """The run's selected and excluded lanes, checked against the pinned policy when it is present."""
602	    workers, excluded = plan_workers(plan), plan_excluded(plan)
603	    if policy is not None:
604	        declared = policy_workers(policy)
605	        if not set(workers) <= set(declared) or not set(excluded) <= set(declared):
606	            raise ValueError("Plan names lanes the pinned policy does not declare")
607	        if "workers" in plan and set(workers) | set(excluded) != set(declared):
608	            raise ValueError("Plan does not account for every declared lane")
609	    if set(plan.get("nodes", {})) != set(workers):
610	        raise ValueError("Plan nodes do not match the selected lanes; inspect retained allocation state")
611	    return workers, excluded

614	def carry_legacy_lanes(runtime: ExportRuntime, state, saver: SqliteSaver | None = None):
615	    """Carry a pre-lane checkpoint's per-lane evidence into the lane state shape.
616	
617	    A checkpoint written before configured lanes stored each lane under `<lane>` and
618	    `<lane>_packet`; the graph no longer has those channels, so `get_state` drops them.
619	    Read them from the raw checkpoint and carry them under `lanes`/`packets` so the launch
620	    evidence survives every export, whether from `export` or from the report written at
621	    each CLI boundary. Runs with configured lanes are returned unchanged.
622	    """
623	    from types import SimpleNamespace
624	    database = runtime.directory / "pipeline.sqlite"
625	    if "workers" in runtime.plan or not database.exists():
626	        return state
627	    config = {"configurable": {"thread_id": runtime.plan["run_id"]}}
628	
629	    def carry(saver: SqliteSaver):
630	        stored = saver.get_tuple(config)
631	        raw = stored.checkpoint.get("channel_values", {}) if stored else {}
632	        values = dict(state.values)
633	        for node in runtime.workers:
634	            if node in raw:
635	                values.setdefault("lanes", {}).setdefault(node, raw[node])
636	            if f"{node}_packet" in raw:
637	                values.setdefault("packets", {}).setdefault(node, raw[f"{node}_packet"])
638	        return SimpleNamespace(values=values, next=state.next, tasks=state.tasks)
639	
640	    if saver is not None:
641	        return carry(saver)
642	    with SqliteSaver.from_conn_string(str(database)) as own:
643	        return carry(own)

659	def build_pipeline(checkpointer, runtime):
660	    """The graph over the runtime's plan: `launch_<lane>` and `verify_<lane>` per selected lane, then the fixed tail."""
661	    workers = list(runtime.workers)
662	    def launcher(node):
663	        return lambda _state: {"lanes": {node: runtime.launch(node)}}
664	    def verifier(node):
665	        return lambda state: {"packets": {node: runtime.verify(node, state["snapshots"])}}
666	    def handoff(_state):
667	        message = ("Awaiting explicit completion signals and automatic freeze." if runtime.plan.get("automatic")
668	                   else f"Type in Claude terminals; provide a handoff for every lane ({', '.join(workers)}), then explicitly freeze.")
669	        decision = interrupt({"kind": "worker_handoff", "message": message})
670	        if decision != {"freeze": True}:
671	            raise ValueError("Explicit freeze required")
672	        return {"snapshots": runtime.freeze()}
673	    def candidate(state): return {"bundle": runtime.candidate(state)}
674	    def review(_state):
675	        _, digest = runtime.validate_bundle()
676	        if runtime.plan.get("automatic"):
677	            from .automatic import review_candidate
678	            decision = review_candidate(runtime)
679	        else:
680	            decision = interrupt({"kind": "independent_review", "bundle_sha256": digest,
681	                                  "bundle_path": str(runtime.directory / "review-bundle.json")})
682	        runtime.validate_review(decision)
683	        save_json(runtime.directory / "review.json", decision)
684	        runtime.event("review", "approved", decision["reviewer"])
685	        return {"review": decision}
686	    def approval(_state):
687	        _, digest = runtime.validate_bundle()
688	        if runtime.plan.get("automatic"):
689	            from .automatic import validate_automatic
690	            validate_automatic(runtime.plan)
691	            decision = {"approve": digest}  # Explicit run-level authority: feature branch only.
692	        else:
693	            decision = interrupt({"kind": "integration_approval", "bundle_sha256": digest,
694	                                  "message": "Approve fast-forward of source branch; no push."})
695	        if decision != {"approve": digest}:
696	            raise ValueError("Explicit exact-bundle approval required")
697	        return {"approved_bundle": digest}
698	    def integrate(state): return {"integrated_commit": runtime.integrate(state["approved_bundle"])}
699	    graph = StateGraph(PipelineState)
700	    launches = [f"launch_{node}" for node in workers]
701	    verifies = [f"verify_{node}" for node in workers]
702	    for node, name in zip(workers, launches):
703	        graph.add_node(name, launcher(node))
704	    for node, name in zip(workers, verifies):
705	        graph.add_node(name, verifier(node))
706	    for name, function in (("handoff", handoff), ("candidate", candidate), ("review", review), ("approval", approval), ("integrate", integrate)):
707	        graph.add_node(name, function)
708	    for name in launches:
709	        graph.add_edge(START, name)
710	    graph.add_edge(launches, "handoff")
711	    for name in verifies:
712	        graph.add_edge("handoff", name)
713	    graph.add_edge(verifies, "candidate")
714	    graph.add_edge("candidate", "review"); graph.add_edge("review", "approval")
715	    graph.add_edge("approval", "integrate"); graph.add_edge("integrate", END)
716	    return graph.compile(checkpointer=checkpointer)

23	DEFAULTS = {"finish": "verified-feature-branch", "permission_mode": "bypassPermissions",

31	def automatic_settings(worker_timeout_seconds: int | None = None, review_timeout_seconds: int | None = None,
32	                       reviewer_transport: str | None = None) -> dict:
33	    """Run-scoped automatic configuration; deadlines and transport are pinned into plan.json at prepare."""
34	    settings = dict(DEFAULTS)
35	    for key, value in (("worker_timeout_seconds", worker_timeout_seconds), ("review_timeout_seconds", review_timeout_seconds),
36	                       ("reviewer_transport", reviewer_transport)):
37	        if value is not None:

43	def validate_automatic(plan: dict) -> None:
44	    settings = plan.get("automatic")
45	    if not isinstance(settings, dict) or not REQUIRED_KEYS <= set(settings) <= set(DEFAULTS):
46	        raise ValueError("Malformed automatic run configuration")
47	    if settings["finish"] != DEFAULTS["finish"] or settings["permission_mode"] != "bypassPermissions":
48	        raise ValueError("Unsupported automatic authority")
49	    for key in TIMEOUT_KEYS:
50	        if type(settings[key]) is not int or not 1 <= settings[key] <= 86400:
51	            raise ValueError("Automatic timeouts must be bounded positive seconds (at most 86400)")
52	    if "reviewer_transport" in settings and settings["reviewer_transport"] not in REVIEWER_TRANSPORTS:

68	            "Do not wait for a human handoff. Stay within assigned ownership; do not commit, merge, push, "
69	            "launch agents, change runtime evidence or switch billing/provider. "
70	            "On completion write the following JSON shape atomically (temporary file then rename) to "
71	            f"{directory / (node + '.completion.json')}. This one output file is allowed outside your worktree. "
72	            "Use status blocked if you cannot finish; never manufacture checks. Write it as your last action, "
73	            "then finish your turn and do not modify more files. Controller checks and independent review "
74	            "still determine acceptance.\n" + json.dumps(example))

77	def read_completion(runtime, node: str) -> dict:
78	    path = runtime.directory / f"{node}.completion.json"
79	    if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file() or path.stat().st_size > 65536:
80	        raise ValueError(f"Invalid completion file for {node}")
81	    item = read_json(path)
82	    expected = {"version", "run_id", "node_id", "launch_token", "status", "summary", "open_assumptions"}
83	    if not isinstance(item, dict) or set(item) != expected:
84	        raise ValueError("Malformed completion signal")
85	    if (item["version"] != "1.0.0" or item["run_id"] != runtime.plan["run_id"] or item["node_id"] != node

87	        raise ValueError("Stale or foreign worker completion signal")
88	    if item["status"] not in {"completed", "blocked"} or not isinstance(item["summary"], str) or not item["summary"].strip():
89	        raise ValueError("Invalid completion status/summary")
90	    if not isinstance(item["open_assumptions"], list) or any(not isinstance(x, str) for x in item["open_assumptions"]):
91	        raise ValueError("Invalid completion assumptions")
92	    if item["status"] == "blocked":
93	        raise RuntimeError(f"Worker {node} explicitly blocked: {item['summary']}")

97	def lanes(runtime) -> list[str]:

102	def wait_handoffs(runtime, *, clock=time.time, sleep=time.sleep) -> None:
103	    """Idle alone never means completion. Deadlines survive controller restart."""
104	    validate_automatic(runtime.plan)
105	    workers = lanes(runtime)
106	    if any((runtime.directory / f"{node}.stop.json").exists() for node in workers):
107	        # Recover a controller crash after durable handoffs/stop intent, before snapshot.
108	        for node in workers:
109	            if read_completion(runtime, node) != read_json(runtime.directory / f"{node}.handoff.json"):
110	                raise RuntimeError("Handoff changed after stop intent")
111	        return
112	    attention: set[str] = set()
113	    while True:
114	        rows = runtime.sessions.inventory()
115	        handoffs = {}
116	        for node in workers:
117	            receipt = read_json(runtime.directory / f"{node}.interactive.json")
118	            started = datetime.fromisoformat(receipt["launch_requested_at"]).timestamp()
119	            if clock() >= started + runtime.plan["automatic"]["worker_timeout_seconds"]:
120	                raise RuntimeError(f"Worker {node} deadline exhausted; no automatic relaunch")
121	            row = runtime.sessions.locate(node, rows)
122	            if row is None:

125	                # A native session reports `blocked` when its turn ended needing a human: a question,

127	                # failure of the lane, and the other lanes keep working. The operator may answer in the
128	                # pane; the worker deadline bounds the wait. No billing/provider fallback.
129	                attention.add(node)

131	                                                   "waiting until its deadline")

134	            path = runtime.directory / f"{node}.completion.json"
135	            if row["state"] in {"idle", "done"} and path.exists():

138	            for node, value in handoffs.items():

247	class ReviewStatus:
248	    """The combined review status plus one status per reviewer, persisted together.
249	
250	    The default reviewer keeps today's single file: its own keys (launch token, session, decision) are
251	    merged into `automatic-review.json`, whose combined `status` wins. Declared reviewers each get
252	    `automatic-review-<id>.json` beside the combined file.
253	    """
254	
255	    def __init__(self, runtime, combined: dict, statuses: dict):
256	        self.runtime, self.combined, self.statuses = runtime, combined, statuses
257	        # Accepted decisions live here until the combined decision persists them (or a deadline/rejection retains them).
258	        self.decisions: dict = {}
259	
260	    @property
261	    def ids(self) -> list[str]:
262	        return list(self.statuses)
263	
264	    @classmethod
265	    def load(cls, runtime) -> "ReviewStatus":
266	        combined = read_json(combined_status_path(runtime))
267	        ids = combined.get("reviewers") or reviewer_ids(runtime.plan)
268	        statuses = {}
269	        for reviewer_id in ids:
270	            path = reviewer_status_path(runtime, reviewer_id)
271	            statuses[reviewer_id] = read_json(path) if path.exists() else {"reviewer_id": reviewer_id, "node_id": review_node(reviewer_id), "status": "pending"}
272	        return cls(runtime, combined, statuses)
273	
274	    def save(self) -> None:
275	        merged = {}
276	        for reviewer_id, status in self.statuses.items():
277	            path = reviewer_status_path(self.runtime, reviewer_id)
278	            if path == combined_status_path(self.runtime):
279	                merged = status
280	            else:
281	                save_json(path, status)
282	        save_json(combined_status_path(self.runtime), {**merged, **self.combined})
283	
284	    def record_decisions(self) -> None:
285	        for reviewer_id, decision in self.decisions.items():
286	            self.statuses[reviewer_id]["decision"] = decision
287	
288	    def supersede_running(self) -> None:
289	        """A reviewer still working when the run is decided is stopped; its status records why nothing waited for it."""
290	        for status in self.statuses.values():
291	            if status.get("status") in {"pending", "launching", "running"}:
292	                status["status"] = "superseded"

295	def read_review_completion(runtime, reviewer_id: str = DEFAULT_REVIEWER) -> dict:
296	    """Accept a reviewer's file only when it validates and is bound to this exact run, reviewer, launch, bundle and candidate."""
297	    from jsonschema.exceptions import ValidationError
298	    from .verification import validate_schema
299	    node = review_node(reviewer_id)
300	    path = runtime.directory / f"{node}.completion.json"
301	    if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file() or path.stat().st_size > REVIEW_COMPLETION_LIMIT:
302	        raise RuntimeError(f"Invalid review completion file ({reviewer_id})")
303	    try:
304	        item = read_json(path)
305	    except ValueError as error:
306	        raise RuntimeError(f"Malformed review completion signal ({reviewer_id}): {error}") from None
307	    try:
308	        validate_schema("reviewCompletion", item)
309	    except ValidationError as error:
310	        raise RuntimeError(f"Review completion signal ({reviewer_id}) violates the schema: {error.message}") from None
311	    status = read_json(reviewer_status_path(runtime, reviewer_id))
312	    bundle, digest = runtime.validate_bundle()
313	    if (item["run_id"] != runtime.plan["run_id"] or item["node_id"] != node or item["launch_token"] != status.get("launch_token")
314	            or item["bundle_sha256"] != digest or item["candidate_commit"] != bundle["candidate_commit"]):
315	        raise RuntimeError(f"Stale or foreign review completion signal ({reviewer_id})")
316	    check_finding_lanes(runtime, item["findings"])
317	    return {"verdict": item["verdict"], "findings": item["findings"]}

326	def wait_reviews(runtime, state: ReviewStatus | None = None, *, clock=None, sleep=None) -> dict:
327	    """Poll every reviewer's receipt. Idle alone never means a verdict; each deadline counts from that reviewer's own launch.
328	
329	    Returns the accepted decisions by reviewer id (also kept in `state.decisions`) as soon as every reviewer approved,
330	    or as soon as one accepted file blocks (the others are not waited for). A rejected file, an expired deadline or
331	    a missing session raises.
332	    """
333	    clock = clock or time.time
334	    sleep = sleep or time.sleep
335	    validate_automatic(runtime.plan)
336	    state = state or ReviewStatus.load(runtime)
337	    timeout = runtime.plan["automatic"]["review_timeout_seconds"]
338	    started = {}
339	    for reviewer_id in state.ids:
340	        receipt = read_json(runtime.directory / f"{review_node(reviewer_id)}.interactive.json")
341	        started[reviewer_id] = datetime.fromisoformat(receipt["launch_requested_at"]).timestamp()
342	    decisions = state.decisions
343	    attention = set()
344	    while True:
345	        rows = runtime.sessions.inventory()
346	        for reviewer_id in state.ids:
347	            if reviewer_id in decisions:
348	                continue
349	            node = review_node(reviewer_id)
350	            status = state.statuses[reviewer_id]
351	            if clock() >= started[reviewer_id] + timeout:
352	                status.update(status="blocked", error="Reviewer deadline exhausted; no second reviewer is launched")
353	                state.save()
354	                raise RuntimeError(f"Reviewer {reviewer_id} deadline exhausted; no second reviewer is launched")
355	            row = runtime.sessions.locate(node, rows)
356	            if row is None:
357	                raise RuntimeError(f"Native reviewer {reviewer_id} missing; reconciliation required")
358	            if row["state"] == "blocked" and reviewer_id not in attention:
359	                # A native session reports `blocked` when it needs a human: a question or a prompt
360	                # it cannot answer itself. The operator may answer in the pane; the deadline bounds it.
361	                attention.add(reviewer_id)
362	                runtime.event("review", "interactive", f"Reviewer {reviewer_id} needs attention in its pane (native state blocked); waiting until the deadline")
363	            if row["state"] in {"idle", "done"} and (runtime.directory / f"{node}.completion.json").exists():
364	                try:
365	                    decision = read_review_completion(runtime, reviewer_id)
366	                except RuntimeError as error:
367	                    status.update(status="blocked", error=str(error))
368	                    state.save()
369	                    raise
370	                decisions[reviewer_id] = decision
371	                status.update(status="accepted", accepted_at=now())
372	                state.save()
373	                if decision_blocks(decision):
374	                    return decisions  # The first block decides; nobody waits for the other reviewers.
375	        if set(decisions) == set(state.ids):
376	            return decisions
377	        sleep(2)

380	def review_candidate(runtime) -> dict:
381	    """Called only by the LangGraph review node. Ambiguous invocations never replay."""
382	    validate_automatic(runtime.plan)
383	    bundle, digest = runtime.validate_bundle()
384	    if combined_status_path(runtime).exists():
385	        state = ReviewStatus.load(runtime)
386	        combined = state.combined
387	        if combined.get("bundle_sha256") == digest and combined.get("status") == "succeeded":
388	            runtime.validate_review(combined["review"])
389	            if combined.get("transport") == "native":
390	                # Accepted earlier, but a stop was not confirmed: retry it (the stop intent makes it idempotent).
391	                for reviewer_id in state.ids:
392	                    if not reviewer_stopped(runtime, reviewer_id):
393	                        runtime.stop_reviewer(reviewer_id)
394	            return combined["review"]
395	        if combined.get("bundle_sha256") == digest and combined.get("transport") == "native" and combined.get("status") in {"running", "needs_reconciliation"}:
396	            # The reviewers kept running while the controller was away: bind what the launches produced, never launch again.
397	            rebind_reviewers(runtime, state)
398	            return _accept_native(runtime, bundle, digest, state)
399	        raise RuntimeError("Prior reviewer invocation needs reconciliation; no automatic relaunch")
400	    cwd = runtime.directory / "review-worktree"
401	    if cwd.exists():
402	        raise RuntimeError("Partial review worktree exists; reconcile rather than overwrite")
403	    subprocess.run(["git", "-C", runtime.plan["repository"], "worktree", "add", "--detach", str(cwd), bundle["candidate_commit"]],
404	                   check=True, capture_output=True)
405	    patch = runtime.directory / "review.diff"
406	    with patch.open("w") as handle:
407	        subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(cwd), "diff", "--binary", runtime.plan["base_commit"], bundle["candidate_commit"]], stdout=handle, check=True)
408	    if reviewer_transport(runtime.plan) == "print":
409	        return _review_print(runtime, bundle, digest, cwd, patch)
410	    return _review_native(runtime, bundle, digest, patch)

413	def rebind_reviewers(runtime, state: ReviewStatus) -> None:
414	    """Resume: every reviewer receipt is rebound to the one session its launch produced; a reviewer without a receipt
415	    (its launch was never issued) leaves the run at needs_reconciliation and nothing is launched."""
416	    combined = state.combined
417	    partial = combined.get("status") == "needs_reconciliation"
418	    for reviewer_id in state.ids:
419	        status = state.statuses[reviewer_id]
420	        receipt = runtime.directory / f"{review_node(reviewer_id)}.interactive.json"
421	        if not receipt.exists():
422	            status.update(status="needs_reconciliation", error=status.get("error") or "No launch receipt; the launch was never issued")
423	            combined.update(status="needs_reconciliation", error=f"Reviewer {reviewer_id} needs reconciliation; no automatic relaunch")
424	            state.save()
425	            raise RuntimeError(f"Reviewer {reviewer_id} needs reconciliation; no automatic relaunch")
426	        if partial or not status.get("session_id"):
427	            try:
428	                bound = runtime.reconcile_reviewer(reviewer_id)
429	            except Exception as error:
430	                status.update(status="needs_reconciliation", error=str(error))
431	                combined.update(status="needs_reconciliation", error=str(error))
432	                state.save()
433	                raise
434	            status.update(session_id=bound["session_id"], background_id=bound.get("background_id"), status="running")
435	            status.pop("error", None)
436	            state.save()
437	    combined["status"] = "running"
438	    combined.pop("error", None)
439	    state.save()

459	def combined_review(runtime, bundle: dict, digest: str, state: ReviewStatus, decisions: dict) -> dict:
460	    """review.json over the set: unanimous approval passes; any block, unresolved P0/P1, missing or rejected verdict blocks."""
461	    entries, findings = [], []
462	    for reviewer_id in state.ids:
463	        status = state.statuses[reviewer_id]
464	        decision = decisions.get(reviewer_id)
465	        entries.append({"reviewer_id": reviewer_id, "session_id": status.get("session_id"),
466	                        "verdict": decision["verdict"] if decision else None, "accepted_at": status.get("accepted_at") if decision else None})
467	        if decision:
468	            findings.extend({**finding, "reviewer": reviewer_id} for finding in decision["findings"])
469	    blocked = any(reviewer_id not in decisions or decision_blocks(decisions[reviewer_id]) for reviewer_id in state.ids)
470	    sessions = [entry["session_id"] for entry in entries if entry["session_id"]]
471	    return {"run_id": bundle["run_id"], "bundle_sha256": digest, "candidate_commit": bundle["candidate_commit"],
472	            "reviewer": ", ".join(sessions), "independent": True, "verdict": "blocked" if blocked else "approved",
473	            "findings": findings, "reviewers": entries}

476	def _decide(runtime, bundle: dict, digest: str, state: ReviewStatus, decisions: dict) -> dict:
477	    """Persist review.json for any verdict; only unanimous approval without blocking findings passes."""
478	    review = combined_review(runtime, bundle, digest, state, decisions)
479	    save_json(runtime.directory / "review.json", review)
480	    state.record_decisions()
481	    blockers = [reviewer_id for reviewer_id in state.ids if reviewer_id in decisions and decision_blocks(decisions[reviewer_id])]
482	    undecided = [reviewer_id for reviewer_id in state.ids if reviewer_id not in decisions]
483	    if blockers or undecided:
484	        for reviewer_id in blockers:
485	            state.statuses[reviewer_id]["status"] = "blocked"  # An approval with an unresolved P0/P1 is contradictory; the run is blocked.
486	        state.save()
487	        raise RuntimeError(f"Independent reviewer blocked the candidate ({', '.join(blockers or undecided)})")
488	    runtime.validate_review(review)
489	    for status in state.statuses.values():
490	        status["status"] = "succeeded"
491	    state.combined.update(status="succeeded", review=review, accepted_at=now())
492	    state.save()
493	    return review

504	def _review_native(runtime, bundle: dict, digest: str, patch: Path) -> dict:
505	    from .pipeline import digest_file
506	    declared = reviewers(runtime)
507	    combined = {"transport": "native", "bundle_sha256": digest, "candidate_commit": bundle["candidate_commit"],
508	                "patch_sha256": digest_file(patch), "status": "launching", "reviewers": [item["reviewer_id"] for item in declared]}
509	    statuses = {item["reviewer_id"]: {"reviewer_id": item["reviewer_id"], "node_id": review_node(item["reviewer_id"]), "transport": "native",
510	                                      "launch_token": str(uuid.uuid4()), "bundle_sha256": digest, "candidate_commit": bundle["candidate_commit"],
511	                                      "status": "pending"} for item in declared}
512	    state = ReviewStatus(runtime, combined, statuses)
513	    state.save()
514	    for reviewer in declared:
515	        reviewer_id = reviewer["reviewer_id"]
516	        status = statuses[reviewer_id]
517	        status["status"] = "launching"
518	        state.save()
519	        prompt = review_prompt(runtime, patch, reviewer) + completion_protocol_prompt(runtime, status["launch_token"], digest, bundle["candidate_commit"], reviewer_id)
520	        try:
521	            launched = runtime.launch_reviewer(reviewer_id, prompt, status["launch_token"], bundle["candidate_commit"])
522	        except KeyboardInterrupt:
523	            issued = runtime.directory / f"{review_node(reviewer_id)}.interactive.json"
524	            if not issued.exists():
525	                # No launch command was issued for this reviewer. Nothing is guessed either way: the operator reconciles;
526	                # the reviewers launched before it keep running and nothing is relaunched.
527	                status.update(status="needs_reconciliation", error="Interrupted before the reviewer launch was issued")
528	                combined.update(status="needs_reconciliation", error=f"Reviewer {reviewer_id}: interrupted before its launch was issued; nothing is relaunched")
529	                state.save()
530	                running = [other for other, item in statuses.items() if item["status"] == "running"]
531	                if running:
532	                    runtime.event("review", "interrupted", f"Reviewer {reviewer_id} was never launched; reviewers {', '.join(running)} were NOT stopped and keep running. "
533	                                  "Resume rebinds them and launches nothing; the run needs reconciliation")
534	                raise
535	            # `claude --bg` was issued (settle poll or pane attach interrupted): the session exists or is
536	            # registering and keeps running. Record what is bound so far; resume binds the rest through
537	            # reconciliation, never through a relaunch.
538	            bound = read_json(issued)
539	            status.update({key: bound[key] for key in ("session_id", "background_id") if bound.get(key)}, status="running")
540	            combined["status"] = "running"
541	            state.save()
542	            runtime.event("review", "interrupted", REVIEW_RESUME_NOTE.format(directory=runtime.directory))
543	            raise
544	        except BaseException as error:
545	            # The launch may or may not have produced a session; only an operator can tell. Never launch again.
546	            status.update(status="needs_reconciliation", error=str(error))
547	            combined.update(status="needs_reconciliation", error=str(error))
548	            state.save()
549	            raise
550	        status.update(session_id=launched["session_id"], background_id=launched.get("background_id"), status="running")
551	        state.save()
552	    combined["status"] = "running"
553	    state.save()
554	    return _accept_native(runtime, bundle, digest, state)
